data.faqs:
#I am by myself. Can I fly?
Yes! We accept solo passengers. However to meet our minimum requirements of 2 passengers per flight, Solo passengers are required to purchase 2 tickets in order to participate in the activity.
#What happens if I miss my flight?
If you missed your flight, you will be considered "No-Show" "No -shows" are non refundable.
You will always have the option to reschedule your flight for another day/time. However, keep in mind that a reschedule fee must be paid prior to rescheduling your tour.
Rescheduling time/date will depend upon our availability.
#Is there a deadline for arriving for my tour?
Yes! Please arrive 20 minutes before your flight. 
Passengers who fail to arrive and check in at least 20 minutes before the scheduled departure time may have their tour duration reduced or asked to reschedule for another time/day with a rescheduling fee. If passenger cannot reschedule, they will be considered a 'no show', with no refund.

#All flights are private? What does it mean?
 Flight will be completely private. Only your group will participate in the flight.

#Is there a weight limit?
Maximum weight per passenger is limited to 250 lbs.; total group weight cannot exceed 480 pounds. Your flight will be cancelled if our weight limit is exceeded.

#Is there an age limit ?
Yes! We recommend children older than 5 years old. All children occupy one seat of the aircraft and need to use the seatbelt for safety.

#Can I buy my ticket in person?
Reservations must be made online prior to your arrival. On site reservations are allowed as long as we have availability. Payment must be made online by visiting www.skytoursmiami.com

#What happens if it is raining at the tour time?
Your flight can be rescheduled in case of rain. We will contact you in case of bad weather. Your tour is subject to weather. If flight can't be reschedule, you will get a full refund.

#What is your Refund Policy?
We offer convenient free cancelation up to 24 hours in advance to your tour. Reservations may only be rescheduled without forfeiture of funds paid with 24 hours’ notice prior to scheduled reservation time by emailing request to infoskytoursmiami@yahoo.com 

No refunds for "No-Show" (If you miss your flight, you will be considered No-Show, and no refund will be given)

Full refunds will apply for flight cancellations made by Sky Tours Miami due to technical issues or any other unforeseen circumstances that could affect your flight.
